headline: Easement for Rhode Island Energy to install an electric utility pole at 100 Freight Street, and parking lot lease renewal for 43 Broad Street.
summary: The meeting covers a utility pole easement on Freight Street and the renewal of a parking lot lease at 43 Broad Street. It also includes a Planning Department recommendation on that lease renewal.
items: Easement for Rhode Island Energy to install an electric utility pole at 100 Freight Street, City right-of-way, communication from Joe Morais, Senior Project Leader, Department of Public Works
Parking lot lease renewal for 43 Broad Street, communication from John Marques, Proprietor, Joshua's LLC d/b/a News Café
Planning Department recommendation regarding the renewal of the lease at 43 Broad Street, communication from Michael Cassidy, Pawtucket Planning Department
location: Pawtucket Municipal Annex, 100 Freight Street, 1st Floor, City Council Conference Room - Room 140, Pawtucket, Rhode Island

You are  requested to attend a meeting of the City Council City Property  Committee, to be held on  
Wednesday, October 7, 2026, at 5:50 p.m., at the Pawtucket Municipal Annex, 100 Freight Street , 1 st 
Floor, City Council Conference Room - Room 140, Pawtucket, Rhode Island. 
 
The purpose of this meeting is for discussion and/or consideration of the following: 
 
1. PUBLIC INPUT PERIOD Must Sign-in or Join via Zoom 10 minutes prior to meeting. 
 
2. Communication from Joe Morais, Senior Project Leader, Department of Public Works, to the 
Honorable Members of the Pawtucket City Council, (Easement for Rhode Island Energy to Install an 
Electric Utility Pole at 100 Freight Street – City Right-of-Way) 
 
3. Communication from John Marques, Proprietor, Joshua’s LLC d/b/a News Café, to the Honorable 
Members of the Pawtucket City Council (Parking Lot Lease Renewal for 43 Broad Street) 
 
4. Communication from Michael Cassidy, Pawtucket Planning Department, to the City Clerk’s Office.  
(Planning’s recommendation regarding the renewal of the lease at 43 Broad Street) 
 
This meeting is being called by Councilor Marlena Martins Stachowiak, Chair, City Property Committee.
